physical.fixing: tool-less, snaps into square or round punched rail holes

configs.description: One FHU-BPSTL-1U-10 panel as FS ships it, one of the ten in the pack.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no render shows the back of the panel square-on, so the clips' backs are plain blocks of the bezel's size.
gaps.wanted: a rear view of the panel
`attrs.physical.weight-kg` (profile `passive` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

chassis.note: the plate is the part: "Dimensions (HxW) 43.8 x 482.6 mm" (datasheet and product page), one steel plate the width of the rack with its ends in the same sheet, so the face is drawn at 482.6 with its clips (the owner's rule of 2026-10-09; lint L43 stands down for a body this wide). Behind the middle of the plate its top and bottom edges fold back into returns, which is the depth.

clips.note: 1 ABS clip(s) at each end (fs/bpstl-clip@1), the bezel 16.8 in from the end: the stencil's left clip at 16.8, its right at 435.3, 0.5 off symmetric, drawn symmetric. Each sits on the middle rail hole of its rack unit (EIA-310), where the stencil and the renders put it; the right-hand clip is the part turned 180, its point and arrow toward the middle as drawn.

color.note: black steel, black ABS clips with a grey slider, as every render shows; "Color: Black".

depth.note: 9.8: FS's dimensioned render of SKU 181854 (x3) prints 0.39 in (9.8 mm) for the return, and that of 181856 the same. The 3D body is the plate and its returns as one box across the full width; the real ends are a single sheet.

eia.note: EIA-310 hole positions: the rail holes of each rack unit stand 6.35, 22.225 and 38.1 mm up from its bottom, and the two rails' holes are 465.1 mm apart across the rack. The plate is taken as centred in the rack units it fills, so a hole's height on the plate is its height in the units less half the difference between the units and the plate.

hooks.note: a 6.7 x 8.1 window centred 9.5 in from each end at the height of each rail hole the clip engages, the clip's hook showing grey in it. The straight-on render of SKU 181855 (g4, 3.104 px/mm, its aspect within 0.1 per cent of the stated 88.25 x 482.6) centres both windows 9.5 from their ends, near the rail hole's 8.75; the stencil draws them 11.95 in, and is not taken. The size is the stencil's. On the 2U the one clip sits between two windows, at the middle holes of the upper and lower unit.

lifecycle.note: checked 2026-10-09 against what the intake holds: the FS product page for this SKU was live when the intake read it on 2026-10-08, and the FS documentation portal's Accessories tree, read the same day, carries no end-of-sale notice for it. No web search beyond FS's own pages was made.

mark.note: FS prints its mark beside the left clip; it is a logo and is not drawn. Its place is reserved as the region `logo-zone`: on the straight-on gallery render of SKU 181854 (g4), calibrated on the plate at 3.13 px/mm across and 3.17 down, the mark runs x 55.3 to 67.4 and y 20.5 to 26.5. The two scales agree to 1.4 percent, which is the only check this face offers; the mark is printed grey on black and its edge is read at 25 levels over the plate.

method.note: the FS Tool-less Blanking Panel Datasheet (portal 5057), FHU-BPSTL-1U-10 column, for the height, width, material and weight; the layout of the face from the FS Blanking Panel Visio stencil, master FHU-BPSTL-1U-10, rendered at 10 px/mm against its 482.6 width, checked against the straight-on gallery render of SKU 181854 (g4) and the dimensioned render (x3), which agree on the number and places of the clips.

packs.note: the datasheet's Package row: 10pcs/pack, the only way FS sells the 1U panel, so the model is the pack's SKU and the base configuration is one panel of it.

rear.note: the back of the plate with the two returns edge-on between the ends and the back of each clip behind its window; no render shows the back square-on and the clips' backs are drawn as plain blocks.

returns.note: the returns run 17.9 to 464.7: the straight-on render of SKU 181854 (g4) at 3.13 px/mm puts the return's top edge 16.9 to 18.9 in from the left end and 463.4 to 465.3 from it on the right; the middle, symmetric.

sides.note: the plate's end edge-on, the returns behind it and the open channel between them.

thickness.note: 1 mm sheet; FS states the material (SPCC) and not its gauge.

weight.note: the datasheet: 5.29 lbs (2.4 kg) for the pack of ten, so 0.24 a panel (derived)
